title: Christlike Service
definition: Christlike Service is the Christlike use of strength, gifts, time, and resources for the good of people and the glory of God.
summary: Christlike Service is humble action for the good of others patterned after Jesus, who came not to be served but to serve.
christFocus: Jesus Christ came not to be served but to serve, and He empowers His people to serve in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the posture of service. Christlike service bends low without losing joy, dignity, or truth. It is not people-pleasing but love expressed through humble obedience to God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because service can become a platform for recognition or a burden fueled by resentment. Jesus shows service rooted in secure sonship and sacrificial love. This doctrine restores humility and purpose to ordinary acts of help.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve where no one may notice, and serve without keeping score. Check whether your service is driven by love, guilt, pride, or fear. Receive Christ's serving love, then extend it to others.
